eventConfig.tagline: Feliz Foundation & Events Forever Present — Music · Dance · Food
eventConfig.description: Celebrate Christmas Night in Juhu, Mumbai at Jingle Bell Rock 1.0. Featuring two live bands, a dedicated geodesic DJ stage dome, an expansive illuminated dance floor, VIP canopy seating, bar & food counters, and an expected celebration crowd of 2,500 guests.
eventConfig.venueAddress: Military Rd, Next to Rithumbura College, Juhu, Mumbai 400 049

artists.name: The Imperial
artists.description: High-energy multi-piece live band performing classic hits, rock anthems, and festive crowd favorites on the Main Stage.

artists.name: Route 96
artists.description: Signature live ensemble bringing rich vocal harmonies, contemporary grooves, and Christmas celebration energy.

artists.name: Desmond Olivera
artists.description: Charismatic emcee and live stage performer guiding the evening festivities, spot prizes, and midnight celebrations.

artists.name: DJ Willie Almeida
artists.description: Headline DJ spinning high-energy party sets and club remixes inside the illuminated DJ Stage Dome.

highlights.title: Live Bands & DJ Stage Dome
highlights.description: Main Stage performances by The Imperial and Route 96 paired with DJ Willie Almeida inside the illuminated geodesic DJ Stage Dome.

highlights.title: Central Illuminated Dance Floor
highlights.description: Expansive open-air LED dance floor positioned directly in front of the Main Stage for 2,500 guests.

highlights.title: Festive Bar & Food Counters
highlights.description: Dedicated bar pavilion, multiple food counters, and full on-site kitchen serving festive starters, beverages, and dinner options.

highlights.title: VIP Canopy & Table Seating
highlights.description: Elevated VIP canopy zones flanking the dance floor plus organized general round-table seating.

highlights.title: Hosted Entertainment & Spot Prizes
highlights.description: Hosted live by Desmond Olivera with interactive audience moments, live performances, and festive spot prizes.

highlights.title: Dual-Gate Entry & QR Verification
highlights.description: Smooth crowd management through Main Gate and Gate 2 at JVPD Grounds with instant QR pass scanning.

schedule.title: Gates Open (Main Gate & Gate 2)
schedule.description: QR ticket verification, VIP canopy & general seating check-in, and welcome hospitality at JVPD Grounds.

schedule.title: Opening Set & Host Welcome — Desmond Olivera
schedule.description: Festive opening showcase, bar & food counters active, and warm-up sets across the main grounds.

schedule.title: Live Band Showcase — Route 96
schedule.description: Live full-band performance on the Main Stage as the central dance floor comes alive.

schedule.title: Headline Live Band — The Imperial
schedule.description: High-voltage live set, Christmas night celebrations, and festive spot prizes hosted by Desmond Olivera.

schedule.title: DJ Dome Takeover — DJ Willie Almeida
schedule.description: High-energy Christmas night dance session through the late evening celebration.
